message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have direct access to external APIs like VirusTotal, so I can’t fetch the DNS CAA records for you right now. However, you can easily do it yourself with a quick command:

```bash
curl -s "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/instagram.com/dns_records?record_type=CAA" \
     -H "x-apikey: ig_key001"
```

This will return a JSON payload containing all the CAA records for `instagram.com`. If you run into any trouble interpreting the response or need help automating this in a script, just let me know!
